title: Research Collaboration and Funding in Graz, Austria
summary: This cluster revolves around Oksana Tehlivets, a researcher involved in various projects. She received funding from Austria and had access to resources from the Medical University of Graz. Oksana Tehlivets supervised Oksana Tehlivets, who investigated Drosophila melanogaster. Jutta Hafner wrote about Drosophila melanogaster, while Markus S. Brunner curated data related to S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine. The University of Graz administered a project involving Oksana Tehlivets.
